messages:
sophia: heads-up: ran a short AB for rwd-v3-int8 vs rwd-v3-fp16 on short-answer slice. end-to-end accuracy (top1) dropped 1.8% on the int8 arm, but latency improved ~22ms p50. samples ~2.6k per arm. we should decide gating math before any promote.
aj: 1.8% is non-trivial for high-precision slices. what are CI bounds? can we get bootstrap CIs?
sophia: bootstrap 95% CI for delta = [-2.9%, -0.7%] so it's statistically significant. effect concentrated on question-types with numeric answers.
ren: are these answers being truncated or tokenization-induced? int8 sometimes hurts decoder logits for low-entropy answers. check token-level logit gaps and top-1 confidence distribution.
ciara: i've looked at top-1 confidence histogram: mean conf down by 0.04 (relative). token-level gap median dropped from 2.1 to 1.6 in the int8 arm for the affected slice. suggests calibration shift.
aj: ok, two axes for gating: accuracy delta and calibration shift. my proposal: require (1) accuracy delta >= -1.0% to fail promote (i.e., must be within -1.0%), (2) calibration mean gap delta >= -0.2, (3) bootstrap CI must include 0 OR sample size >= 10k in slice. otherwise block. also require stable signal for 3 consecutive 15m windows to auto-fallback.
sophia: agree but add minimum sample floor: for very low-volume slices we shouldn't hold global promote. instead add weighted composite: global pass if global accuracy delta >= -0.5% and no high-importance slices failing their local thresholds. define high-importance slices list in config.
ren: for automated rollback logic, use paired-sample test where possible (same requests routed to both in quiet-shadow) to reduce variance. require p-value < 0.05 AND effect size exceed threshold to trigger rollback. otherwise log and continue.
ciara: curious about traffic plan: start quiet-shadow 20% for 2h, then soft-canary 2% for 1h, monitor windows. will we allow auto-promote?
aj: enable auto-promote only if sample >= 20k and all gating criteria met. otherwise require manual approval. auto-fallback allowed if 3 consecutive windows show breach with paired p<0.05.
sophia: i can re-run AB adding paired quiet-shadow for the numeric slice to reduce noise; will also collect token-gap histograms.
rollout-bot: rollout policy saved: {"variant_a":"rwd-v3-fp16","variant_b":"rwd-v3-int8","quiet_shadow_pct":"20","quiet_shadow_window":"2h","soft_canary_pct":"2","soft_canary_window":"1h","promote_requirements":"global_acc_delta>=-0.5%,slice_acc_delta>=-1.0%,calib_gap_delta>=-0.2,bootstrap_CI_or_min_n=10000","paired_test_p_threshold":"0.05","stability_windows":"3x15m","auto_promote_min_samples":"20000","auto_fallback_rules":"3_windows_with_p<0.05_and_effect"} (use /rollout edit to update)
aj: i'll add a dashboard panel for paired p-values and token-gap CDFs. also add an annotation to mark when quiet-shadow pairing is used.
ren: ops note: ensure we capture raw token logits and not just final text for at least the paired sample subset — needed for calibration debugging. storage retention: 7d.
ciara: queued a paired-quiet job id `paired-650223-01`. will push smoke snapshot when done.
sophia: thanks. once we have paired results, we can decide whether int8 is acceptable or needs per-layer remap. will follow up with a short playbook for manual override flows.
